err_channel_this_guild: ❌ The channel must be on **this** server.
status_field_alert_need_ch: — *Open **`/raidconfig`** and pick a **channel** — otherwise no announcement.*
status_auto_on: **Yes** — reminder ~1 h before + fight on time.
status_footer: Timezone: BOT_TIMEZONE · Times use correct localization (pytz). “raid alert 1h” logs at INFO.
config_help_desc:
Use **`/raidconfig`** to open the **interactive panel** (menus + buttons).

• **Channel**: ~1 h alert + battle messages.
• **Without auto**: admins use **`/raidstart`**.
• **`/raid statut`** (ephemeral): recap without changing settings.
config_panel_desc:
Pick options below — **each change saves** immediately.
**Channel** · **weekday** · **hour** · **minutes** (steps of 5) · **Auto** buttons · **HH:MM** for exact minute.
**Save** closes the panel with a confirmation · **Close** closes without a message.
raid_already_running: A raid is already running on this server.
raid_week_limit_hit: ❌ The **1 × /raidstart per week** limit was already reached for this server.
raid_start_ok:
✅ **Raid started** in {mention}.
• ISO week recorded: **{wk}** — you can’t use **`/raidstart`** on this server again until **next week**.
• **Automatic** raid (**Auto: ON** in **`/raidconfig`**) is **not** affected.
phase_low: The boss **staggers** — a few more hits!
phase_full: The boss holds the line… for now.
mode_already: ✅ You’ve **already chosen** the mode for this raid.
mode_saved:
✅ Mode saved: **{label}** ({tier})
• Damage per correct answer (roll): **~{lo}–{hi}**
• **Finisher XP** bonus if you finish the boss: **+{fin}** (excluding damage / MVP / time split).
join_already: ✅ You’re **already signed up** for this raid. Wait for the signup timer to end.
join_ok: You’re registered for this raid. **{n}** participants so far.
join_embed_title: 🎮 Pick your minigame (only you see this)
join_embed_desc:
Choose the **challenge type** for **all** your rounds.
• **Easy** = character (4 choices) and **genre** — wrong picks = **less damage** if you eventually get it. **Medium** = year, episodes, higher/lower (same). **Hard** = **screenshot** (type the title in channel like **`/animequiz`**) and blurred **guess who**.
• Harder modes → **more damage** and **higher finisher** bonus.
• _If you don’t pick before signup ends → **{default_mode}**._
hub_not_participant: You weren’t signed up at the start of the raid. You can watch the fight in the channel.
hub_round_done: You already finished your round (answered or time ran out).
hub_has_challenge: You already have a challenge open — check your **ephemeral** messages above.
hub_burst: ⏳ Too many clicks — try again in **{s}s**.
hub_load_fail: ❌ Couldn’t load a challenge. Try again.
emb_gw_fallback: Type the character name in this channel.
emb_aq_fallback: Type the title in this channel.
boss_dead_answer: 🏆 The boss is already defeated — this answer wasn’t counted.
challenge_gc:
Round **{rn}/{mr}** — click the **correct** character.
Anime hint: _{hint}_
*(Wrong pick = that button disappears for you only.)*
challenge_gy:
Round **{rn}/{mr}** — in what year did **{title}** start?
*(Wrong pick = button disabled.)*
challenge_ge:
Round **{rn}/{mr}** — how many episodes for **{title}**?
*(Wrong pick = button disabled.)*
challenge_gg:
Round **{rn}/{mr}** — which genre among these matches **{title}**?
*(Only one is valid — AniList list format.)*
challenge_aq:
Round **{rn}/{mr}** — **which anime** is this from the cover?
➜ **Type the title in this channel** (like **`/animequiz`**: EN / JP / synonyms).
**One try** — ~{secs} s. Your message will be **deleted** right away.
• `jsp` / pass = forfeit (**0** damage).
challenge_gw:
Round **{rn}/{mr}** — **type the character name in this channel** (like **`/guesswho`**).
Anime hint: _{hint}_ · **One try** — ~{secs} s.
_Your message may be **deleted** (if the bot can manage messages) to reduce spoilers._
hit_finisher:
💥 **{name}** — **finisher**: **{dmg:,}** damage!
🏆 The boss collapses — **{maxhp:,}** HP total.
hit_high:
⚔️ **{name}** hits for **{dmg:,}**! The boss still stands (**{hp:,}** HP, **{pct}%**).
🔊 _The melee rages._
hit_mid:
💢 **{name}** deals **{dmg:,}** — the boss staggers! **{hp:,}** HP (**{pct}%**).
🔥 _You can feel it waver._
hit_low:
🩸 **{name}** — **{dmg:,}** damage! Only **{hp:,}** HP left (**{pct}%**).
⚡ _One more push!_
raid_start_body:
✅ **{n}** participant(s) — the boss has **{hp}** HP (_{per} × {n} for the team_).
• Up to **{maxr}** rounds — **~{secs} s** max **per round** if someone hasn’t answered yet.
• **Damage per correct answer** depends on the **mode** you picked at signup (see your ephemeral message) — harder modes hit harder.
• **Hits** and the **log** (embed) show the fight; mistakes / timeouts stay in the log.
round_timeout_msg: ⏰ **Round {n}** over — the boss still stands (**{hp}** HP).
force_finish: 🔥 **Final salvo!** The raid ends: the boss falls (**{hp}** HP left counted as defeated).
victory_summary: **{np}** player(s) · **{nr}** round(s) · duration **~{dur}** · damage dealt **{td}** (boss **{maxhp}** HP)
promo:
⚔️ **BOSS RAID (weekly)** — Signups open **~{join}s** _(**fixed** timer from start; it doesn’t extend with each signup)_.
• Each player gets their **own** challenge (**ephemeral** in the channel).
• **Random damage** per correct answer: range depends on **mode** at signup.
• Up to **{maxr}** rounds; boss HP = **players** × {per_player}.
• When **everyone** finishes (success, fail, or timeout) → next round without waiting for the timer.
• XP: base + damage share + MVP + fastest round + finisher.
signup_desc: Click to join the fight. **Voice not required.**
alert_1h: @here ⏰ **Boss Raid** in **1 h** — get ready (quiz / AniList chars)!
raid_no_channel: ❌ No raid channel configured. Open **`/raidconfig`** and pick a **channel** in the menu.
raid_limit_cmd:
❌ **Limit reached**: **`/raidstart`** can only be used **once per week** per server (ISO week **{wk}**). Try again next week.
_**Auto** weekly raid (**Auto: ON** in **`/raidconfig`**) doesn’t count toward this limit._
raid_confirm_desc:
You’re about to start an immediate **Boss Raid**.

• **After confirming**, this server can’t use **`/raidstart`** again until **next week** (**1 × per ISO week**, here: **{wk}**).
• **Auto** weekly raid (**Auto: ON** in **`/raidconfig`**) is **not** consumed by this limit.

**Raid channel:** {ch}

Click **Confirm** only if you accept.
test_alert: @here 🧪 **TEST** — in 1 h this would be the **Boss Raid** alert.
test_forbidden: ❌ I can’t send a message in {ch}. Check bot permissions.
chain_intro: ⛓️ **Chain quiz** — each correct answer bumps difficulty. Wrong answer or `jsp` = stop. Type the anime title (FR/EN/JP).
chain_wrong: ❌ It was **{title}**. Chain over: **{streak}** · Total XP: **{xp}**.
gw_desc:
**{diff}** — on win: **+{xp} XP**.
Type the **character name** ({sec} s). Anime hint: _{hint}_
gw_footer_list: Character from your AniList (completed, watching, rewatching, paused).
gw_footer_global: AniList empty or unavailable — global draw (popularity).
gw_timeout: ⏰ Time’s up — it was **{name}** _(difficulty **{diff}**, reward **+{xp} XP**)_
gw_win: ✅ Nice! It was **{name}** — you earn **+{xp} XP** _(**{diff}**)_
gw_lose: ❌ Not quite — the answer was **{name}** _( **{diff}** would have given **+{xp} XP**)_
